purpose: Prospectively define handling of terminal semantic-invalid or unavailable uncertainty outputs before correctness-based DEV analysis.

primary_estimator_comparison.definition: Use only frozen DEV500 items having a valid SC5_MAJORITY terminal record and a valid VC_SELF_EVAL terminal record.
primary_estimator_comparison.reason: SC5 and VC must be compared on the same recommendations/items so Brier and discrimination differences are not confounded by different validity subsets.

sc5_semantic_invalid.primary_comparison: exclude item from both estimator candidates

vc_semantic_invalid_with_valid_sc5.primary_comparison: exclude item from both estimator candidates

invalid_handling.missing_terminal_record_after_collection: collection-complete freeze must fail; do not begin correctness analysis
invalid_handling.duplicate_terminal_record: halt normalization and require protocol review

constant_baseline.primary_comparison: Grouped OOF correctness prevalence estimated from training folds of the paired common-valid set.
constant_baseline.post_selection_eval_baseline: After winner selection, freeze empirical correctness prevalence using all valid DEV observations for the selected estimator; use that constant for untouched EVAL comparison.

post_selection_refit.rule: Refit the selected estimator/calibrator mapping on all valid Calibration-DEV observations available for the winning estimator.

correctness_definition: SC5 majority recommendation equals hidden ground-truth label. VC_SELF_EVAL never changes the frozen recommendation.
fail_closed_conditions: paired common-valid data do not retain all five frozen folds
no valid candidate calibrator can be evaluated under the frozen core
frozen selection rules do not uniquely resolve a winner
collection completeness or identifier consistency checks fail
